scientific_question: Does truthful source-outcome information change closed-loop terminal success beyond a representation- and token-footprint-matched neutral explicit-field control?

units.selection_rule: exhaustive R54 outcome-blind eligible suffix eligible[40:]

field_control.shared_prefix:
[Retrieved Memory Context]
[Source outcome codes: S=success, F=failure, U=unknown]
field_control.S_shuffled: within-retrieval nonidentity permutation of S/F preserving exact per-prompt multiset

shuffle_freeze.algorithm: random.Random(int(SHA256(seed|task_id)[:16],16)); repeatedly shuffle truthful S/F sequence until nonidentity; preserve exact multiset

Qwen.seal: no Qwen effect inspection until all 189 scheduled Qwen units are terminal or prospectively classified technical-missing

Llama.seal: no Llama effect inspection until all 132 Llama scheduled units are terminal or prospectively classified technical-missing

primary.test: two-sided exact paired sign test alpha=0.05

decision.EFFECT_DETECTED: complete-pair two-sided exact p<0.05 AND worst-case missing-pair exact sign-test p<0.05 AND conservative technical-missing paired-RD sensitivity excludes 0 in the same direction
decision.NO_EFFECT_DETECTED: otherwise; does not imply equivalence, practical smallness, or prompt-format-only explanation

gatekept_correctness.correctness_sensitive: same-direction complete-pair exact p<0.05 AND worst-case missing-pair exact sign-test p<0.05 AND conservative technical-missing paired-RD sensitivity excludes 0

executor_replication.successful_replication: effect independently detected in same direction as Qwen primary using the same complete-pair + worst-case-missing sign-test + paired-RD robustness gate
executor_replication.otherwise: report independent estimate; no null/equivalence upgrade

analysis.multiplicity: fixed hierarchy: Qwen T-P primary at alpha .05; Qwen T-S gate-kept at alpha .05 only after primary; Llama separately labelled executor replication; diagnostics cannot rescue primary

pre_exposure_infrastructure_failure.definition: failure before first treatment-conditioned inference dispatch; includes task/container reset/build failures and transport failures provably before dispatch

post_exposure.missing_pair_sensitivity: for m technical-missing pairs among N planned: paired RD worst/best bounds must exclude 0 in the observed direction AND the maximum two-sided exact paired sign-test p-value over every admissible left-only/right-only/concordant completion of the missing pairs must remain <0.05; applies to Qwen T-P, gate-kept Qwen T-S, and any Llama result labelled successful replication
